name: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd
title: Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd - 532892 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Annuity-led FY26 with Operating PAT up 16% to ₹2,360 cr and Q4 run-rate ₹661 cr; AMC AUM 1.5 lakh cr, but MF market share in flows and broking face headwinds.

triggers.label: Brokerage revenue up ~33% YoY in Q4
triggers.quote: In Q4FY26, brokerage revenue growth is ~33% YoY.

triggers.label: Digital fintechs taking new SIPs
triggers.quote: 60%, 70% of the new SIPs are getting opened by these finte ch platforms.

triggers.label: AUM ₹1.8 lakh cr, 15% above FY26 avg
triggers.quote: Our latest AUM at ₹1.8 lakh cr is already 15% higher than the FY26 avg. of ₹1.57 lakh Crs.

triggers.label: MF market share in flows falling
triggers.quote: our market share in MF flows have come down from 7.5% to around 3%

guidance.value: Expects meaningful variable returns in coming periods; no numeric guidance
guidance.quote: we don't give out guidance. However, as explained in our last con call

red_flags.label: MF flow market share fell from 7.5% to ~3%
red_flags.quote: our market share in MF flows have come down from 7.5% to around 3%

red_flags.label: Fintech platforms taking new SIPs
red_flags.quote: 60%, 70% of the new SIPs are getting opened by these finte ch platforms.

red_flags.label: Mark-to-market loss on ~₹9,000 cr investment book
red_flags.quote: our investment book, which currently stands at around ₹9,000 crores. These are unrealized losses

evasions.quote: Yes. Sir, just one last data keeping question.
As far as the variable additional return is concerned, so we don't give out guidance.
